mutants.label: pushed-ness read from the remote-tracking ref instead of a fresh ls-remote
mutants.find:
ref = f"refs/heads/{branch}"
    out = _git_out("ls-remote", "--", remote, ref)
    for line in out.splitlines():
        sha, _, name = line.partition("\t")
        if name == ref:
            return sha
    return None

mutants.label: squash base ignores pushed session commits and rewinds to the session base
mutants.find: squash_base = base if prefix == 0 else session[prefix - 1]

mutants.label: merge commits in the session range no longer skip the squash
staged-but-uncommitted changes no longer skip the squash
the squash never fires: any unpushed count reads as nothing to collapse
mutants.find:
if report.unpushed == 1:
        report.action = "none"
        report.reason = "only one unpushed commit; nothing to collapse"
        return report
mutants.replace:
if report.unpushed >= 1:
        report.action = "none"
        report.reason = "only one unpushed commit; nothing to collapse"
        return report

mutants.label: an ls-remote failure fails open as 'nothing pushed' instead of skipping
net-empty unpushed run no longer skips, so the boundary invents or fails a commit
mutants.find:
old_tree = _git_out("rev-parse", f"{head}^{{tree}}")
    if _git_out("rev-parse", f"{squash_base}^{{tree}}") == old_tree:
        report.squash_base = None
        report.reason = "unpushed commits are net-empty; a squash would need an empty commit"
        return report

mutants.label: detached HEAD no longer skips: the branch is guessed from --abbrev-ref
mutants.find:
branch_proc = _run_git("symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD")
    if branch_proc.returncode != 0:
        report.reason = "HEAD is detached; cannot determine the branch to compare against"
        return report
    branch = branch_proc.stdout.strip()

mutants.label: a base that is not an ancestor of HEAD no longer skips the squash
interleaved pushed/unpushed classification guesses a prefix instead of refusing
[control] reorder the action and reason writes on the success report
mutants.why: Two writes to distinct attributes of the same in-memory dataclass with no read of each other's field between them (reason reads only report.unpushed, set earlier on both orders); squash() is single-threaded and the Report is observed only after it returns, so the order is inert on every path the suite can reach. It would stop being inert only if something observed the half-written Report mid-assignment, which nothing in this script can do.
mutants.find:
report.action = "squashed"
    report.reason = f"collapsed {report.unpushed} unpushed session commits into one"
mutants.replace:
report.reason = f"collapsed {report.unpushed} unpushed session commits into one"
    report.action = "squashed"
